unit.title: Systems and Simultaneous Constraints
unit.act: Act V - Satisfying several conditions at once
unit.role: Extend linear reasoning to multiple equations, variables, and feasible regions.
unit.governingQuestion: Which values satisfy several requirements simultaneously?
unit.storyArc: Intersections represent simultaneous truth. Graphing estimates solutions, substitution replaces equals by equals, elimination combines equations to remove a variable, and applications reveal when two variables are the natural model.
outcomes: Interpret a system solution as satisfying every constraint.
Solve systems graphically, by substitution, and by elimination.
Classify one, zero, or infinitely many solutions.
Model totals, mixtures, rates, and break-even situations.
Graph systems of inequalities and interpret feasible regions.
unit.investigation: Design a production or allocation plan subject to budget, time, and minimum-output constraints.
unit.mastery: Mixed systems require method selection and interpretation of the ordered-pair solution.
